investigation.title: Remote Agents: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocking All Agent Provisioning Evals
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-10-03T01:00Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error indicating the swarm gateway — an AWS ELB in us-east-2 serving /v1/agents — was unreachable during agent provisioning. Because the failure occurs at the very first HTTP call (POST /api/agents), no evidence was collected and all four required contract fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) are missing.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway (an AWS ELB endpoint in us-east-2 proxied through POST /api/agents) returned HTTP 502 with error code bad_gateway during agent provisioning. The production-api layer could not reach the downstream swarm service at the redacted ELB URL /v1/agents, causing the createAgent call in run-status-probes.mjs (line 1885) to throw before any evidence could be written. All three sibling checks share the identical error message, confirming the failure is in the shared upstream swarm gateway dependency rather than in any individual check's logic. No historical run data is available to determine when this gateway last succeeded.

investigations.summary: The published observability snapshot at https://cypher-asi.github.io/aura-os/observability/status.json was last written 664 minutes ago, exceeding the contract maximum of 300 minutes. investigations.rootCause: The workflow or process responsible for regenerating and publishing status.json to https://cypher-asi.github.io/aura-os/observability/status.json has not run successfully in at least 664 minutes (approximately 11 hours). The snapshot's source field is "desktop-nightly-release", indicating the last successful publish came from a desktop nightly release rather than a github-actions scheduled workflow, which may itself indicate the scheduled workflow has been failing or skipped. The root cause is a missed or failed snapshot publication cycle, not a web infrastructure or routing problem.
